Forty-one flags

The road to Time

Five tiers, run roughly in order, though most of each tier can be taken in whatever sequence your group can manage.

ITier IThe first four planes12 of 12

Disease, Justice, Innovation and Nightmares. Four short roads that run in parallel, and the only tier you can start the moment you arrive.

The Plane of Disease3/3

  • ✓Adler FuirstelPlane of TranquilityHail him and hear him out. Nothing in the Plane of Disease will let you past the doorway without this.Entry to the Plane of Disease
  • ✓GrummusPlane of DiseaseThrough the castle and down. He is the reason the zone exists.
  • ✓Elder FuirstelPlane of TranquilityGo back and hail the elder once Grummus is down.The Crypt of Decay opens from here

The Plane of Justice3/3

  • ✓MavuinPlane of JusticeFind him below and hail him. Every trial checks for this before it will speak to you.The six trials
  • ✓A trial before the TribunalPlane of JusticeSix trials, and you need one. Whichever you take sets the same flag, so pick the one your group can hold.TakenExecutionFlameHangingLashingStoningTorture
  • ✓Mavuin's casePlane of JusticeReturn to Mavuin with the trial behind you.The Plane of Storms and the Plane of Valor

The Plane of Innovation2/2

  • ✓Xanamech NezmirthafenPlane of InnovationNitram Anizok has to survive the walk. Keep him out of what Xanamech is pointing at, then hail him.Entry to the Plane of Innovation
  • ✓The Manaetic Behemoth2 of 2 stages · Plane of InnovationGiwin Mirakon starts it and finishes it. The Behemoth wakes on its own once the factory is stirred up.

The Plane of Nightmares4/4

  • ✓Adroha JezithPlane of TranquilityHail her before you go anywhere near the hedge.Entry to the Plane of Nightmares
  • ✓A Construct of NightmaresPlane of NightmaresThelin Poxbourne opens the maze and takes the proof afterwards.
  • ✓Terris ThuleThe Lair of Terris ThuleBehind her own gate, at the end of the path.
  • ✓Elder PoxbournePlane of TranquilityThe last hail of the tier.
IITier IIDecay, Torment, Storms and Valor7 of 7

The Plaguebringer's crypt, Saryrn's tower, the giant camps and the prismatic dragon. Four zones that open together and can be run in any order.

The Crypt of Decay2/2

  • ✓The Carprin line2 of 2 stages · The Crypt of DecayWork down the family. Tarkil Adan is the exception -- hail him, do not kill him.
  • ✓BertoxxulousThe Crypt of DecayThe kings first, then the Plaguebringer himself.Torment, and the road on

Torment, the Plane of Pain3/3

  • ✓Fahlia ShadygladePlane of TranquilityThe preflag. Hail her before you set foot in Torment.Entry to Torment
  • ✓Tylis NewleafTormentHe is caged partway up. Reach him, then deal with the Keeper of Sorrows and speak to him again.
  • ✓Saryrn2 of 2 stages · TormentSaryrn and everything she brings with her, then back down the tower to report it.

The Plane of Storms1/1

  • ✓Askr the Lost4 of 4 stages · The Plane of StormsFour deliveries, gathered from the giant camps and handed over in pieces.

The Plane of Valor1/1

  • ✓Aerin`DarThe Plane of ValorThe keyed fight at the top of the zone, and the trap door under it.The Halls of Honor
IIITier IIIThunder, Honor, Zek and the Tower16 of 16

The long tier. Agnarr's bastion, three trials in the halls, the warlords of Drunder, and six floors of the Burning Prince's tower.

Torden, Bastion of Thunder2/2

  • ✓Agnarr, the Storm LordBastion of ThunderFour wings, four courtyard towers, then the ride up.
  • ✓KaranaBastion of ThunderHe appears once Agnarr is finished. Hail him -- this one is a conversation, not a fight.

The Halls of Honor3/3

  • ✓The trial of Trydan FayeThe Halls of HonorNorth-east below. The custodian, then Rydda`Dar.
  • ✓The trial of Rhaliq TrellThe Halls of HonorNorth-west below. Three rooms of villagers, and they all have to live.
  • ✓The trial of Alekson GarnThe Halls of HonorSouth-east below. Same shape, higher stakes -- lose one and the trial is lost.

The Temple of Marr1/1

  • ✓Lord Mithaniel MarrThe Temple of MarrHis champion has to fall before he can be touched.Drunder

Drunder, the Fortress of Zek3/3

  • ✓Tallon ZekDrunderOne side of the fortress. The wall behind him is the way out.
  • ✓Vallon ZekDrunderThe other side, and the same trick to leave.
  • ✓Rallos Zek the WarlordDrunderBoth sons again, then the father. He leaves the room partway through and you follow.The elemental planes, through Tranquility

  • ✓RizlonaThe Tower of Solusek RoA wing boss.

The Plane of Knowledge1/1

  • ✓Grand Librarian MaelinPlane of KnowledgeA second door to the elements. If the tower did not give you the access it should have, he will.
IVTier IVThe elemental planes5 of 5

Fire, Air, Water and both halves of Earth. Four bosses, five flags, and the pieces of the key you will need at the end of it.

Doomfire, the Burning Land1/1

  • ✓Fennin Ro, the Tyrant of FireThe Plane of FireA guardian, then waves, then the tyrant.

Eryslai, the Kingdom of Wind1/1

  • ✓Xegony, the Queen of AirThe Plane of AirFour rings for four essences, combined into the key that reaches her.

Reef of Coirnav1/1

  • ✓Coirnav, the Avatar of WaterThe Plane of WaterFour waves. The small ones are the dangerous ones.

Vegarlson, the Earthen Badlands1/1

  • ✓A Mystical Arbitor of EarthThe Plane of EarthFour ring events across the badlands, then the arbitor at the bottom.

Ragrax, Stronghold of the Twelve1/1

  • ✓The Avatar of EarthThe Stronghold of the TwelveThe chieftains, the warlord, then the twelve of the Rathe Council. The avatar is last.
VTier VThe Plane of Time1 of 1

One flag left, and it is a conversation rather than a fight. Everything above it was the price.
